image_description: A flat-lay photograph displaying four vintage comic book covers arranged in a grid. The top-left cover features an orange alien creature; the top-right shows a superhero figure in blue and red; the bottom-left depicts a green dinosaur-like monster; and the bottom-center shows two grey alien figures. All covers exhibit retro sci-fi artwork styles with bold, stylized typography.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly landscape-oriented (wider than they are tall), contradicting the 'portrait-oriented' requirement of the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All four items display vibrant, colorful illustrations and prominent, stylized titles consistent with comic book or pulp magazine aesthetics.
The comics are laid flat facing up; the spine edge is not visible to inspect for staples.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Periodical format for serialized graphic storytelling.

artifact_observations.location: Title text on all four covers
artifact_observations.reasoning: The titles are visually convincing as stylized fonts at a glance, but upon inspection, they are nonsensical strings of pseudo-characters (e.g., 'ZQ ZR...', 'TITIS...'). They fail to form readable words, which is a hallmark AI generation artifact when attempting to replicate typography.
The white background separating the comics has a slightly smeared, painterly texture rather than a clean photographic surface, suggesting minor generative blur.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom-right corner of the bottom-left comic
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edge of the paper appears to warp and blend slightly into the background, lacking a crisp physical boundary.
